summary: Go 1.26 upgrade causes non-determinism check failures in workflowcheck tests on Windows, specifically when tests access os.Stderr, blocking CI.
userImpact: Developers cannot merge code as CI tests fail on Windows due to Go 1.26 non-determinism detection.
rootCause: Go 1.26 introduced stricter non-determinism detection that fails tests accessing os.Stderr, which was previously allowed or ignored.
resolutionDetails: Fixed in PR #2187 by updating workflowcheck to handle Go 1.26 non-determinism checks.
keyQuote: CI upgraded to Go 1.26, now this fails, need to investigate further
